final: WITH per AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS d, AVG(rental_rate/replacement_cost) AS r FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND replacement_cost IS NOT NULL AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, d AS avg_rental_duration, r AS avg_ratio FROM per UNION ALL SELECT 'ALL', AVG(d), AVG(r) FROM per
